items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: we had one of the French boys playing with us, John of French, he played the trumpet, he left.

ctx.x: Could you tell me that full names? Oh yeah.

The one that left, Clarence Hall, the first one left. And then we had one of the French boys playing with us, John of French, he played the trumpet, he left. And after a while, Herbert Trish, played the saxophone, he left. And Roland Arsenault, he left. And Leroy Robinette, he left. And Leroy Robinette, he left. And Leroy Robinette, he left. And Leroy Robinette, he left. What instruments?
Well, Leroy played, Arsenault played trumpet.
